label: WRONG
reason: Guide pages (auth, ci, self-hosting config, cli config) all use genGuideMeta, which builds metadata from guide frontmatter and a /guides pathname. The home page, the reference pages (generateReferenceMetadata) and the ai-prompts page (generateAiPromptMetadata) are other kinds of page with their own metadata shapes, and 0 of 3 are mistakes, so a new non-guide page under app/** would be wrongly warned. Nothing in eslint.config.cjs enforces it. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since the proposal lists only the root page as an outlier.
